intentEvidence: Create missing Obsidian daily notes without opening each day, including backfilled ranges that use nested folder formats.
problem: Manually creating daily notes for long periods or ensuring continuity when notes are missing is tedious and error-prone.

relations.evidence: It also depends on obsidian-daily-notes-interface for Daily Notes settings and note creation.

summary: A utility that automatically creates missing daily notes across specified date ranges while respecting existing Obsidian Daily Notes configurations.
